name: threatconnect
label: ThreatConnect
description:
ThreatConnect connector for the v3 REST API. Supports indicator reputation lookups, listing, on-demand bulk indicator pulls, and scheduled threat-intel ingestion. Authenticate using HMAC (Access ID + Secret Key) or a Bearer Token (PAT).

Ingestion has a dependency on the Threat Intel Management Solution Pack.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Indicator Type Filter
ingestion_config_schema.name: indicator_type
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Restrict ingestion to a single ThreatConnect indicator type. 'Any' pulls all types.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Owner Filter (Optional)
ingestion_config_schema.name: owner
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Restrict ingestion to indicators owned by this Source/Community/Organization. Defaults to the connector's Default Organization.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Ingestion Begin From
ingestion_config_schema.name: last_pull_datetime
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Pull only indicators modified at or after this datetime. Updated automatically by the scheduler after each run.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Reputation
ingestion_config_schema.name: reputation
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Default reputation applied to ingested indicators.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Confidence
ingestion_config_schema.name: confidence
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Default confidence applied when an indicator does not carry one.

ingestion_config_schema.title: Per-Run Limit (Optional)
ingestion_config_schema.name: limit
ingestion_config_schema.tooltip: Cap indicators ingested per run. Leave blank for full pagination.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: api_base_url
fields.description: The URL of the ThreatConnect server (e.g. https://app.threatconnect.com).

fields.title: Authentication Type
fields.name: auth_type
fields.tooltip: HMAC: per-request signature using Access ID + Secret Key. The signature covers the full request target (path + query string), per TC's documented scheme. Bearer Token: ThreatConnect Personal Access Token sent as 'Authorization: TC-Token <token>' (TC's documented token scheme).
fields.description: Authentication method used to call the ThreatConnect v3 API.

operations.title: Fetch Indicators (Bulk)
operations.description: Bulk-pulls indicators from ThreatConnect with optional type / owner / modified-since filters and full pagination. Used by scheduled data ingestion and available on-demand.

parameters.title: Indicator Type
parameters.name: indicator_type
parameters.tooltip: Restrict the pull to a single ThreatConnect indicator type.

parameters.title: Owner
parameters.name: owner
parameters.tooltip: Restrict the pull to indicators owned by this Source/Community/Organization. Defaults to the connector's Default Organization.

parameters.title: Modified Since
parameters.name: modified_since
parameters.tooltip: ISO 8601 datetime; only indicators with lastModified >= this value are returned.

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.name: page_size
parameters.tooltip: Indicators fetched per API page. ThreatConnect caps this at 1000.

parameters.title: Limit (Optional)
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Cap total indicators returned across all pages.
